items.html: And every aspect of these has in it Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin, both in the lights and in the vessels. For there are small vessels of Ibur, and the aspect of their light is the Nefesh of Ibur; and there are intermediate vessels of Yenika, and their light is the Ruach of Yenika; and there are inner vessels of Mochin, and their lights are the Neshamot of Mochin.
